metadata.title: Kim Valles Personal Training Program
metadata.purpose: Kim's actual current training program — the gold standard reference for TRAIN. When a client profile closely matches Kim's (intermediate-advanced female, body recomp, upper/lower split, full gym, 4 days/week), this program serves as the primary blueprint.

weekly_structure.wednesday: Active recovery — Reformer class, Hot Pilates, Hike, Reservoir, or Rest
weekly_structure.thursday: Quad focused lower body + Sled Pushes
weekly_structure.friday: Upper body hypertrophy + Battle Ropes + Stairmaster

biceps.status: Minimum — intensity compensates via failure sets and static holds

calves.status: Good — split across both lower days

monday.name: Monday — Glute Focused Lower Body + Cardio
monday.focus: Glute dominant — hip hinge and isolation priority

exercises.name: Hip Thrusts — TRISET
exercises.variation: Full drive (2 sec hold at top) → Pulses → Static hold
exercises.cue: Full drive with 2 second hold at top. Pulses keep tension constant. Static hold is peak contraction — breathe through it.
exercises.kim_note: The anchor of the session. The TRISET format (full, pulses, static) creates massive glute stimulus in one exercise.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift — Glute Focused
exercises.cue: Push hips back, not down. Feel the glute stretch at the bottom. Drive hips forward at the top, squeeze hard.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cue: Weaker leg first. Slight forward torso lean to bias glutes. Lower straight down, drive through front heel.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl — Single Leg Lying
exercises.cue: Slow eccentric — 3 seconds down. Squeeze hamstring at peak contraction.

exercises.name: Glute Medius Cable Kickbacks
exercises.cue: Hips square. Feel the outside of the glute. Full range, squeeze at end.
exercises.kim_note: Cable adds constant tension throughout the range — better glute medius stimulus than bodyweight.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise → Standing Calf Raise Pulses (bodyweight)
exercises.cue: Seated hits soleus deep. Standing pulses finish the gastroc. Full range on both.
exercises.kim_note: The combo hits both heads of the calf — seated for soleus depth, pulses for gastroc burn.

cardio_finisher.name: Stairmaster
cardio_finisher.purpose: Posterior chain conditioning, caloric expenditure, glute endurance

tuesday.name: Tuesday — Upper Body Strength Focused + Core
tuesday.focus: Strength stimulus — heavier loads, 6-8 rep ranges on primary movements

exercises: Reach one arm up chest opener → Thread the needle

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Core braced. Don't arch lower back. Full lockout at top.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Ups
exercises.variation: 2 sets close grip + 2 sets wide grip
exercises.cue: Initiate from the lats. Drive elbows to hips. Dead hang at bottom, chin over bar at top.
exercises.kim_note: Heavier than previous version — 6-8 reps for strength stimulus. Close grip = lower lats + biceps. Wide grip = upper lat width.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Incline Chest Press
exercises.cue: 3-second eccentric is the work. Lower to upper chest, press up and slightly in.
exercises.kim_note: Now 6-8 reps — strength focused to match the day's intent.

exercises.name: Upright Cable Rear Delt Rows — Elbows Flared
exercises.cue: Elbows drive up and wide — not straight up. Flared position targets rear delt and upper back.
exercises.kim_note: Replaced T-Bar rows here. Upright cable row with elbows flared is an elite rear delt builder.

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raises
exercises.cue: Lead with elbows. Slight forward lean. Feel the lateral head — not the traps.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
exercises.cue: Pull to upper chest. Slight lean back. Feel the lats — not the arms.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Extensions
exercises.cue: Elbows locked in place — only forearms move. Full extension at bottom.
exercises.kim_note: Cable version — constant tension throughout the range vs dumbbell.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curls
exercises.cue: Full range. Squeeze at peak. Cable maintains tension at the bottom — don't lose it.
exercises.kim_note: Cable version — constant tension at the bottom where dumbbells go slack.

core_workout.name: Core Circuit
core_workout.format: 3 supersets — complete all 6 exercises as a circuit, rest 60s, repeat
exercises: 3b. Low Plank Hold → Rainbow Hip Taps (3b: 10 sec hold → fail)
core_workout.kim_note: This circuit is hard. By round 3 you should be fighting for every rep. Moved to Tuesday — upper body strength day so lower body is fully recovered.

wednesday.name: Wednesday — Active Recovery
wednesday.kim_note: Wednesday is intentional recovery. The variety of options means it never feels like a chore. Movement clears energy and supports recovery so Thursday is powerful.

thursday.name: Thursday — Quad Focused Lower Body + Sled Pushes
thursday.focus: Quad dominant with hamstring and posterior chain support

exercises.name: Goblet Squat — Drop Set
exercises.cue: Sit deep — chest tall, elbows inside knees. Drop set: no rest between weight reductions.
exercises.kim_note: Drop set structure: 2 heavy weighted sets then strip to bodyweight and go to failure. Quad and glute burner.

exercises.name: Straight Leg RDLs — Hamstring Focused
exercises.cue: Legs straighter than standard RDL. Deep hamstring stretch at the bottom. Drive hips through at top.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunges
exercises.cue: Smith machine guides the path — focus on depth and front heel drive. Step back, lower straight down.
exercises.kim_note: Smith machine allows heavier loading on reverse lunge with guided stability.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Feet hip width. Don't lock knees at top — constant tension. Control descent.

exercises.name: Single Leg Extensions
exercises.cue: Full lockout — squeeze quad hard at top. 3-second slow lowering. Single leg keeps both sides equal.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions — Posterior Chain Focused
exercises.cue: Hinge at hip — not lower back. Feel glute and hamstring doing the work. Don't hyperextend at top.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise → Standing Calf Raise Pulses (bodyweight)
exercises.cue: Same protocol as Monday — full range seated, then standing pulses to burn out.

conditioning_finisher.name: Sled Pushes
conditioning_finisher.kim_note: Explosive. Drive from hips and legs. Stay low. Leave everything on the last round.

friday.name: Friday — Upper Body Hypertrophy + Battle Ropes + Stairmaster
friday.focus: Higher reps, drop sets, supersets — metabolic stress and time under tension

exercises.name: Lateral Raises — Drop Set
exercises.cue: Lead with elbows. Full drop set — no rest between weight reductions.
exercises.drop_set_note: 3 weighted sets within each drop set

exercises.name: T-Bar Row — Drop Set
exercises.cue: Drive elbows back. Squeeze shoulder blades at end. Drop set — strip weight and keep going.
exercises.drop_set_note: 3 weighted sets within each drop set
exercises.kim_note: New addition on Friday — T-bar drop set as an opener hits back with massive volume before supersets.

exercises.name: SUPERSET A — Close Grip Chest Press + Diamond Push-Up
Close Grip Chest Press
exercises.cue: Hands closer than shoulder width. Lower to mid-chest. Inner chest and triceps.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up (use bench or assisted if needed)
exercises.cue: Hands in diamond. Lower all the way. Push to full extension. True failure.

exercises.name: SUPERSET B — Seated Cable Row + DB Pullover
Seated Cable Row or Row Machine
exercises.cue: Drive elbows back. Squeeze shoulder blades together. Control the return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.cue: Lower dumbbell overhead with slight elbow bend — feel the chest and lat stretch. Press back to start.
exercises.kim_note: Pullover bridges the chest and back in one movement. Adds chest volume while complementing the row. Helps thoracic mobility and shoulder health.

exercises.name: SUPERSET C — Seated Dip Machine + Single Arm Supported Bicep Curls
Seated Dip Machine
exercises.cue: Full extension at bottom. Control the return. Tricep doing the work.

exercises.name: Single Arm Supported Bicep Curls
exercises.execution_note: Support removes all cheat momentum — pure bicep. Go to true failure every set.
exercises.cue: Arm supported — zero swinging. Curl to peak, hold 2 seconds. Lower slow. Fight for every rep.

conditioning_finishers.name: Battle Ropes
conditioning_finishers.variations: Alternating waves, double waves, slams, circles
conditioning_finishers.kim_note: Arms are already fatigued — the ropes finish them. 20 on, 40 off keeps every round maximal.

saturday.name: Saturday — Full Rest
saturday.kim_note: Complete rest. No training, no cardio. Let the body recover and supercompensate.

sunday.name: Sunday — Hot Pilates + Yoga
sunday.kim_note: Hot pilates and yoga close the week. Mobility, core stability, nervous system reset. The perfect complement to 4 days of heavy training.

progression_guide.week_1_to_2: Establish movements. RPE 7-8. Learn the drop set and triset formats.
progression_guide.week_3: Add weight on all primary compound movements where RIR allows. RPE 8-9.
progression_guide.week_4: Deload — reduce sets by 40%, maintain load.
progression_guide.week_5_new_mesocycle: New baseline above week 1. Add 1 set to primary compounds on Monday and Thursday.
progression_guide.ongoing: Track every weight. Beat last week somewhere every session.

personalization_steps: Keep the 4-day split structure — Mon lower glute, Tue upper strength, Thu lower quad, Fri upper hypertrophy
Adjust exercises for client equipment if different from full gym
Scale volume to client experience level
Adjust conditioning finishers based on client cardio preference
Replace active recovery options with client's preferred movement
Write all notes in Kim's voice referencing client identity statement and vision
